label: dYdX v4 (indexer)
terms_note: Public indexer HTTP API (no key, no signature: reads only). The docs are HTML (no OpenAPI published at the indexer: /v4/swagger.json answers 404). /v4/perpetualMarkets answers {"markets": {"BTC-USD": {...}}} keyed by ticker. A malformed ticker answers 400 {"errors":[{"msg":"ticker must be a valid ticker (BTC-USD, etc)"}]}. dYdX has no bid/ask on the indexer (orderbook is separate); the ticker uses the oracle price. Trading itself happens on-chain through the dYdX chain (signed transactions), not this API.

list_markets.note: Every perpetual market (BTC-USD ...), status and margin parameters in raw; paged locally.

get_ticker.note: last is the oracle price; volume is the 24h USD volume.

get_candles.note: interval: 1m 5m 15m 30m 1h 4h 1d; newest first; volume in the base token.

not_offered.me: dYdX accounts are chain addresses; there is no authenticated identity on the indexer.
not_offered.get_balances: Subaccount balances need a chain address (GET /addresses/{address}/subaccountNumber/{n}), which is not an input of trading.get_balances; not mapped.
not_offered.list_orders: GET /orders needs an address and subaccount; not an input of the verb.
not_offered.place_order: Orders are signed chain transactions (MsgPlaceOrder), not indexer HTTP calls.
not_offered.cancel_order: Cancellations are signed chain transactions (MsgCancelOrder), not indexer HTTP calls.
